import datetime

# Extract key facts

tier = customer.get('membership_tier', customer.get('tier', 'standard')).lower()
is_prime = customer.get('prime_member', customer.get('is_prime', False))
order_date_str = order.get('order_date', '')
subtotal = order.get('subtotal', 0)
discount_code = order.get('discount_code')
discount_amount = order.get('discount_amount', 0)
today = datetime.date(2026, 6, 15)

# Determine categories of items
item_categories = []
for item in items:

    item_categories.append(cat)

print(f"Item categories: {item_categories}")
print(f"Tier: {tier}, Prime: {is_prime}")
print(f"Delivery date: {delivery_date_str}")
print(f"Order date: {order_date_str}")
print(f"Subtotal: ${subtotal}, Discount code: {discount_code}, Discount amount: ${discount_amount}")

# Calculate return windows per category
for i, item in enumerate(items):
    cat = item_categories[i]
    # Base window by category
    if cat == 'electronics':
        base_days = 15
    elif cat in ('clothing', 'kitchen', 'accessories'):
        base_days = 30
    elif cat == 'books':
        base_days = 14
    else:
        base_days = 30  # default
    
    # Extensions
    extra = 0
    extensions = []
    if tier in ('gold', 'platinum'):
        extra += 15
        extensions.append(f"+15 days ({tier} member)")
    if is_prime:
        extra += 15
        extensions.append("+15 days (Prime shipping)")
    
    total_days = base_days + extra
    
    # Seasonal check (orders in Nov/Dec extend through Jan 31 next year)
    if order_date_str:
        order_dt = datetime.date.fromisoformat(order_date_str)
        if order_dt.month in (11, 12):
            seasonal_deadline = datetime.date(order_dt.year + 1, 1, 31)
            extensions.append(f"Seasonal extension through {seasonal_deadline}")
    
    # Calculate deadline from delivery date
    if delivery_date_str:
        delivery_dt = datetime.date.fromisoformat(delivery_date_str)
        deadline = delivery_dt + datetime.timedelta(days=total_days)
        grace_deadline = deadline + datetime.timedelta(days=15)
        days_remaining = (deadline - today).days
        grace_remaining = (grace_deadline - today).days
    else:
        deadline = "N/A (not yet delivered)"
        grace_deadline = "N/A"
        days_remaining = "N/A"
        grace_remaining = "N/A"
    
    # Restocking fee
    restocking_note = "No restocking fee (unless opened electronics returned for changed_mind)"
    if cat == 'electronics':
        base_fee = "15% of item price"
        if tier == 'platinum':
            fee_note = "Waived (Platinum member)"
        elif tier == 'gold':
            fee_note = "50% off → 7.5% effective"
        elif tier == 'silver':
            fee_note = "25% off → 11.25% effective"
        else:
            fee_note = "No discount (Standard tier)"
        restocking_note = f"{base_fee} for opened items (changed_mind). Tier discount: {fee_note}"
    
    # Return shipping
    if subtotal >= 50:
        shipping_note = "Free return shipping (order subtotal ≥ $50)"
    else:
        shipping_note = "$8 return shipping fee (order subtotal < $50)"
    
    print(f"\n--- {item['name']} ({cat}) ---")
    print(f"  Base return window: {base_days} days")
    if extensions:
        print(f"  Extensions: {', '.join(extensions)}")
    print(f"  Total return window: {total_days} days from delivery")
    if delivery_date_str:
        print(f"  Delivery date: {delivery_date_str}")
        print(f"  Return deadline: {deadline} ({days_remaining} days remaining)")
        print(f"  Store-credit grace deadline: {grace_deadline} ({grace_remaining} days remaining)")
    print(f"  Restocking fee: {restocking_note}")
    print(f"  Return shipping: {shipping_note}")

# Bulk clawback check
num_items = len(items)
print(f"\n--- Additional Policy Notes ---")
print(f"Total items in order: {num_items}")
if discount_code and num_items >= 3:
    print(f"Bulk discount clawback may apply if return drops remaining items below 3 ($5/remaining item)")
else:
    print("No bulk discount clawback applicable")

# Free shipping clawback
if subtotal >= 100:
    print("Free shipping clawback: $8 may be deducted if return drops remaining subtotal below $100 (changed_mind only)")
else:
    print("No free shipping clawback (original subtotal < $100)")

# Repeat category surcharge
from collections import Counter
cat_counts = Counter(item_categories)
repeat_cats = {c: n for c, n in cat_counts.items() if n > 1}
if repeat_cats:
    print(f"Repeat category surcharge: $5 per additional return in same category for: {repeat_cats}")
else:
    print("No repeat category surcharge (items are in different categories)")
